reference: Four wet shallow-water Riemann patterns. Independently integrate F-wE in time at both moving boundaries by adaptive quadrature with wave crossing breakpoints. A translated hydraulic jump on a shared boundary has dissipation rate 9/8 and is counted only in the right interval.
